checks.criterion_zh: 问题、一个动作、示例、验证、下一步齐全且顺序清楚
checks.criterion_en: Question, one action, example, check, and next step are present and clear

checks.criterion_zh: 新手能理解术语；必要风险和前置条件可见；深入内容可选
checks.criterion_en: Terms are understandable; essential risks and prerequisites are visible; depth is optional

checks.criterion_zh: 示例性质明确；事实有对应证据且没有夸大验证层级
checks.criterion_en: Examples are labeled; factual claims have supporting evidence without overstating the verified level

checks.criterion_zh: 中英文结论、限制、风险和下一步一致
checks.criterion_en: Chinese and English agree on conclusions, limits, risks, and next steps

checks.criterion_zh: 资源来源、许可、版本、核查日期及复核触发条件完整
checks.criterion_en: Resources include provenance, license, version, check date, and recheck trigger

checks.criterion_zh: 公开内容不含私有材料或可重识别信息；代码、技能和素材复用有许可
checks.criterion_en: Public content excludes private or re-identifying material; code, skills, and assets have reuse permission

checks.criterion_zh: 一个未被指导过答案的新手尝试了核心动作并记录困难及结果
checks.criterion_en: A real novice attempted the core task without being coached to the answer, with difficulties and results recorded

checks.criterion_zh: 声明的业务结果有实际观测，包含范围、时间窗口和限制
checks.criterion_en: Claimed business outcomes have actual observations with scope, time window, and limits
